x: Johnny Johnson, our "guest" member from Sheffield, was another who turned up on October 6th. It speaks well for his enthusiasm, as apparently he only docked at Tilbury early in the morning, and had come practically straight along to Belgrave Hall to give us his greetings personally.

A warm up for the National team but also the chance for newcomer Johnny Johnson to break the hour for Six miles. His margin of 3½ minutes suggests that it will not be long before a 7 in the hour badge also comes his way.
